questions.question: In which region of operation do minority carriers dominate near the oxide-semiconductor interface?
What determines the capacitance of the oxide layer in a MOS capacitor?

answers.b: Thickness of the oxide layer and its permittivity

questions.question: What happens to the width of the depletion region when a positive gate voltage is applied to a p-type MOS capacitor?
Which condition corresponds to the flat-band voltage in a MOS capacitor?

answers.a: The bands are flat, with no bending in the semiconductor.
answers.b: The inversion layer is fully formed.
answers.c: The oxide-semiconductor interface is highly charged.
answers.d: The depletion region is at its maximum width.
